purpose: Explicit, machine-checked disposition of every test module excluded from the broad pytest collection. A module may not be silently excluded: it is either gated through a wrapper, or it is unrunnable offline for a named, re-verified reason. test_legacy_dispositions.py re-checks each entry on every run, so restoring a missing dependency (or a new failure mode) makes the disposition visibly stale.

test_llama_interface.py.scope_note: October 11 edition: this module's ast-based structural checks read llama_gui.py and owner_conversation_service.py as source text. Both contain the private Porch integration and are not published, so the module cannot run here. In the September edition llama_gui.py had no Porch integration and the module ran in the ordinary collection.

test_api1_control_plane.py.scope_note: Historical API1 acceptance suite. Its oracle (the AAB1 authentication prototype in the untracked scratchpad) is not part of the repository. The API1 control plane is disabled by default and is not imported by ordinary waking. Ordinary human-authority behaviour is exercised by test_human_session_binding.py and test_human_waking_authority_end_to_end.py.

test_api2_lr1_s1.py.scope_note: Historical API2 LR1 suite; same absent AAB1 oracle. API2 is disabled by default and outside ordinary waking.

test_hir1_registration.py.scope_note: Historical HIR1 registration acceptance suite; same absent AAB1 oracle and a live-database copy. Bound-human authority on the ordinary route is covered by test_human_session_binding.py and test_human_waking_authority_end_to_end.py.

test_api2_control_plane.py.scope_note: Requires a copy of the live migrated canonical provenance database and a dated live-DB backup file. Canonical production history must not be copied or mutated to satisfy a test; API2 is disabled by default.

test_compatibility_harness.py.scope_note: Substrate-comparison harness over frozen evaluation packages that are not repository content. Not an owner capability.

test_judge_rubric.py.scope_note: Substrate-evaluation rubric over the same absent frozen packages. Not an owner capability.

test_substrate_evaluation.py.scope_note: Substrate-evaluation runner over the same absent frozen packages. Not an owner capability.

test_decision_path_core_parity.py.scope_note: Parity test between decision_path_core.py and the frozen scratchpad/hdi2 prototype it was promoted from. The prototype is not repository content, so the historical parity claim cannot be re-established here; decision_path_core itself is exercised by ordinary tests.

test_anaxi_dev.py.scope_note: A thin pytest wrapper that execs the developer tool tools/anaxi_dev.py, which is not part of the published reference distribution (it is a host development convenience, not production code). It contributes no checks here.

test_human_waking_authority_end_to_end.p.scope_note: October 11 edition: this custom-runner suite imports llama_gui, which now imports the private Porch implementation (pulse), not published. It is removed from the pinned suite registry for this edition (see custom_runner_suites.json october_edition_removed_suites) and contributes no checks here.

test_llama_launch.py.reason: October 11 edition: this module tests llama_launch.py, which imports llama_gui.py, which contains the private Porch integration (pairing store, TLS fingerprint, Porch listener, owner-conversation submission). llama_gui.py, llama_desktop.py and llama_launch.py are not published, so this module is removed rather than shipped unrunnable. In the September edition llama_gui.py had no Porch integration and this module collected normally.
